   "source": [
    "# SDF Utilities\n",
    "\n",
    "`isoext.sdf` is a small toolbox of signed distance functions for\n",
    "testing and demos. Nothing in the library requires it: extraction\n",
    "only sees the values you put on the grid, however you compute them.\n",
    "{doc}`grids` shows examples with raw PyTorch.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {

    "import torch\n",
    "import isoext\n",
    "from isoext.sdf import *\n",
    "from isoext import viewer\n",
    "\n",
    "grid = isoext.UniformGrid([128, 128, 128])\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Meshes\n",
    "\n",
    "`TriangleMeshSDF` turns a triangle mesh into a signed distance function, so a\n",
    "mesh can be sampled into a grid, edited or combined like any other\n",
    "field, and extracted again.\n",
    "\n",
    "```python\n",
    "TriangleMeshSDF(vertices, faces, signed=True)\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "`isoext.assets.load_mesh` downloads a few well-known test meshes on\n",
    "first use and caches them:\n",
    "\n",
    "- `\"armadillo\"` ({cite:t}`krishnamurthy1996`), `\"bunny\"`\n",
    "  ({cite:t}`turk1994`) and `\"dragon\"` ({cite:t}`curless1996`), courtesy\n",
    "  of the Stanford Computer Graphics Laboratory, for research use\n",
    "- `\"spot\"` from {cite:t}`crane2012`, public domain\n",
    "\n",
    "The armadillo, sampled on a 256 cell grid and extracted again:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-03T07:32:01.542929Z",

     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-03T07:32:02.353283Z",

   "source": [
    "vertices, faces = isoext.assets.load_mesh(\"armadillo\")\n",
    "armadillo = TriangleMeshSDF(vertices, faces)\n",
    "\n",
    "fine = isoext.UniformGrid([256, 256, 256])\n",
    "fine.set_values(armadillo(fine.get_points()))\n",
    "v, f = isoext.dual_marching_cubes(fine)\n",
    "print(f\"{len(faces):,} mesh triangles in, {len(f):,} out\")\n",
    "viewer.embed(v, f, color=\"lightsteelblue\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The distance is the distance to the closest triangle, found through a\n",
    "bounding volume hierarchy on the GPU ({cite:t}`ericson2005`;\n",
    "{cite:t}`jones2006` survey the approaches). The sign is the generalized\n",
    "winding number ({cite:t}`jacobson2013`), evaluated with the tree-based\n",
    "approximation of {cite:t}`barill2018`, so meshes with holes like the\n",
    "bunny and the dragon still get a sensible sign. `sign=\"parity\"` counts\n",
    "ray crossings instead ({cite:t}`nooruddin2003`), which needs a closed\n",
    "mesh.\n",
    "\n",
    "The gradient is the direction away from the closest point, so\n",
    "`get_sdf_normal` and `project_to_surface` work on a mesh SDF, and\n",
    "`closest_points` returns the closest point on the mesh and its triangle\n",
    "directly:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-03T07:32:02.715865Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-03T07:32:02.715695Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-03T07:32:02.719769Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-03T07:32:02.719566Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "distances: [0.1756, 0.1375]\n",
      "closest points: [[-0.01, -0.0093, 0.725], [0.6087, 0.4526, 0.5696]]\n",
      "faces: [281187, 12731]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "p = torch.tensor([[0.0, 0.0, 0.9], [0.5, 0.5, 0.5]], device=\"cuda\")\n",
    "q, face = armadillo.closest_points(p)\n",
    "print(\"distances:\", [round(d, 4) for d in armadillo(p).tolist()])\n",
    "print(\"closest points:\", [[round(x, 4) for x in row] for row in q.tolist()])\n",
    "print(\"faces:\", face.tolist())"
   ]
  },

    "### MandelbulbSDF\n",
    "\n",
    "A distance estimator for the Mandelbulb fractal of\n",
    "{cite:t}`white2009`. The values approximate\n",
    "the distance to the surface rather than being an exact SDF; fewer\n",
    "iterations give a smoother shape.\n"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "## CSG Operations\n",
    "\n",
    "Combine shapes using Constructive Solid Geometry:\n",
    "\n",
    "| Operation | Description |\n",
    "|-----------|-------------|\n",
    "| `UnionOp([...])` | Combine shapes (min of SDFs) |\n",
    "| `IntersectionOp([...])` | Keep overlap (max of SDFs) |\n",
    "| `NegationOp(sdf)` | Invert inside/outside |\n",
    "| `SmoothUnionOp([...], k)` | Smooth blend with radius k |\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-03T07:32:02.948389Z",

     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-03T07:32:02.985505Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-03T07:32:02.985302Z"
    }

   "source": [
    "# Sphere with a hole drilled through it\n",
    "sphere = SphereSDF(radius=0.7)\n",
    "hole = CuboidSDF(size=[0.3, 0.3, 2.0])\n",
    "drilled = IntersectionOp([sphere, NegationOp(hole)])\n",
    "\n",
    "grid.set_values(drilled(grid.get_points()))\n",
    "v, f = isoext.marching_cubes(grid)\n",
    "viewer.embed(v, f, color=\"orchid\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Transformations\n",
    "\n",
    "| Transform | Description |\n",
    "|-----------|-------------|\n",
    "| `TranslationOp(sdf, offset)` | Move by `[x, y, z]` |\n",
    "| `RotationOp(sdf, axis, angle)` | Rotate around axis (degrees by default) |\n"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "# Two spheres with smooth blending\n",
    "s1 = TranslationOp(SphereSDF(radius=0.4), offset=[-0.3, 0, 0])\n",
    "s2 = TranslationOp(SphereSDF(radius=0.4), offset=[0.3, 0, 0])\n",
    "blended = SmoothUnionOp([s1, s2], k=0.15)\n",
    "\n",
    "grid.set_values(blended(grid.get_points()))\n",
    "v, f = isoext.marching_cubes(grid)\n",
    "viewer.embed(v, f, color=\"tomato\")"
   ]
